# Independent native portrait mobile review

Six opaque outputs were reviewed against the frozen supported-native-portrait task and unchanged strict rubric. Four individual outputs pass; two fail. This is not a matched comparison or adoption decision, and none of the original F09 trials were regraded or pooled.

The reviewer opened all12 actual primary images and independently decoded dimensions, opacity and native-result byte identity. Every one of48 required checks has an explicit result, and all five quality dimensions have independent rationales. All52 completed tools were classified from actual commands/native semantics; all60 bundle files, normalized item hashes and event lines are bound. ImageGeneration returns actual image bytes, so absence of a separate image_view is not proof the author could not inspect a generated image.

The two preserved failures are:

- `review-82f1387ba536341b`: both SELECTED app labels are sans serif, contrary to supplied serif branding. The usable opaque pair has correct price/flow/size, but the mandatory brand check fails. The response candidly declares the typography check failed and stops at two calls.
- `review-f294dbae2bc643d6`: the first delivered screen has real transparency (alpha0–255), compromising its paper canvas/readability, and app step/Selected labels are sans serif. Raw-screen and exact-brand checks fail. The response candidly discloses the transparency. iOS status typography is a separate permitted system element, not an excuse for these app-label mismatches.

Actual delivered dimensions are984×1599,887×1774,941×1672 and852×1846. Each response reports its actual files correctly. These are supported native portraits; no exact1179×2556 support is requested or claimed. All outputs preserve exact Family membership/$100/year, use exactly two generation calls, and leave product inputs unchanged.

Four manual passes covered check/authority coverage, actual pixels and native flow/brand, contradictions and disclosure, and final bindings/limits. Partial supplied-guidance prose was exposed in one exported sed output; subsequent guidance outputs were withheld from reviewer display without altering bundles. Response wording and prior infrastructure work also limit blinding. No variant mapping, fixture source or raw-trial lookup was performed. No model execution, rerender, product changes or additional generation occurred during review.

`verify-bindings.py` verifies integrity and coverage only, not quality. Original six review JSONs are immutable. Any subsequent user acceptance amendment must be recorded separately and cannot replace these strict grades. Parent verification and adoption remain separate.
